output.brief:
What is going on: the drop is concentrated where two things happened together. Dock Street and Westgate use the app and lost their coordinators on 1 May. Regulars there lost their standing weekly slots, because the app's basic tier needs staff to rebook them before each Thursday release. Of 213 April regulars at those two sites, 88% of those who lost their slot are now inactive, against 11% of those who kept it. Millbrook kept its coordinator and stayed flat, and Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but kept its paper roster and also stayed flat. The background-check renewal hit all sites equally and does not explain the pattern. Commonplate is not supported by the evidence.

Confidence: moderate-to-good on the pattern. The site data are a single extract, and the exit survey and callback notes are small. Do not cancel RotaWeave or suspend background checks (the county and insurer require them). Next: restore booking support at Dock Street and Westgate now, using an admin seat, as the first step. Phone lapsed regulars to offer their old slots back, and recheck numbers in 60 days.
